hook.line: (Filipino) Maybe this SEO is what will make your videos go viral.
hook.visual: Black frame, then a man on a pink wall points a finger at camera; one-word captions and an orange 3D 'Search Engine Optimization' sticker flips in at 1.5 s.

beats.what: Punch-in on the presenter pointing at camera as he names SEO.
Orange 'Search Engine Optimization' word-art animates in under the 'SEO' caption.
Cut to a hand holding a phone over a dark topographic background: the demo starts.
White hand-drawn arrow points at the TikTok search bar with 'selfiestick tripod' typed.
Copies the suggested search phrases into a note for the caption.
Pastes the keywords into the post caption screen.
Adds hashtags, picking ones with the most posts from the suggestion list.
Cut back to the presenter to wrap up, with zoom punches on key words.
Red 'Like & Follow' sticker with like/heart/thumb icons pops in.

why_it_works: The acronym is decoded on screen (SEO -> big animated 'Search Engine Optimization') within 2 s, so a beginner is not lost.
Real phone UI held in a hand over a textured background shows the exact taps to copy, making it a save-worthy how-to.
Zoom punches (4.48 per min) and many motion events (15.22 per min) keep the face segments moving even though the speech is slow.
Hand-drawn arrow points at the one field that matters in the search screen.
weaknesses: Opens on a black frame, wasting the first fraction of a second.
Over half the runtime is silent (silence share 0.534); the screen demo runs on music alone.
Weak loop (0.278) and a generic like-and-follow ending.
Phone UI text is tiny and hard to read at phone size.
for_robert: Decode jargon with one big animated word-art sticker right as he says it (SEO -> Search Engine Optimization); Fred could pop up holding that sticker. Avoid opening on black.
